paper_title: Relational Extensions vs. Dedicated Vector Engines: An Empirical Performance Benchmark of PostgreSQL (pgvector) and Qdrant in Hybrid RAG Architectures
notes: The data pipeline created one deterministic 1,000,000-passage sample so that all dataset sizes are nested prefixes.
The paper reports held-out measurements only at 100,000 and 250,000 vectors.
Tuning results are retained for provenance but are not paper measurement results.
